written: 2026-11-24, before the first KPI computation; revised the same day, still before any computation, to measure one frozen system version
scope: Offline KPI table (work plan task B7, page 4). Reads archived runs and CAVIAR XML only; no network, no provider call.

system_version.last_src_change: 8376171 Perception possible_category: route unclear security suspicions to review
system_version.rule: A run counts only if run_all_kpi.sh recorded this src tree and pyproject blob with no uncommitted change in src/ or pyproject.toml. Later commits that touch neither keep the same version.

live_settings.models: gemini-3.6-flash for video, investigation, verification and reporting (GEMINI_*_MODEL)
live_settings.thinking: HIGH for every role (hard-coded at this version)

video_choice: The _pts files are used where the CLI rejects the original MPEG (LeftBox, TwoEnterShop1front, Meet_WalkTogether1: 'Source lacks usable frame PTS'). Meet_WalkSplit uses its _pts.mp4, whose XML alignment is verified in experiments/mvp_evaluation/CAVIAR.md.
xml_reader: security_augmented.annotations.parse_annotations (direct <box> element; never the old regex reader)
xml_time: XML frame n is display index n of the analysed video; seconds = (frame_pts[n] - first_display_pts) * time_base, from the run's own analysis.video

critical_events.person_fell: For each object whose context is 'drop down': the first frame where its situation changes from 'moving' to 'inactive' (the person is on the floor). The 'drop down' context alone spans the whole scenario, from the person's arrival while still walking, so it does not date the fall. Getting up again is not an event.
critical_events.object_placed: First frame of each object track whose role contains 'object' (CAVIAR 'leaving object' role on the bag box). Same rule as experiments/stationary_objects.
critical_events.object_removed: Last annotated frame + 1 of that object track, unless the track reaches the last 3 XML frames (then the object is still present at the end: no event).
critical_events.fire: Not present in CAVIAR: not measurable.

matching.rule: An item matches an XML event of a compatible category when [item.start - tol, item.end + tol] contains the XML instant. One-to-one, greedy by increasing distance from the XML instant to the item interval, ties by item start then XML instant. A second item on an already matched event is a false item.
matching.headline: strict

human_facing_items: Supported events of a security category (security_augmented.workflow.PRIORITY_LABELS, as counted in review.counts.supported_security) plus every review.alerts entry (needs_review, including 'possible' alerts). Zone entries without a configured zone are not shown to a person (review.not_alerted) and are excluded.
raw_alert_proxy: Initial-phase Perception observations whose category, or possible_category, is a security category. This stands in for raw detector alerts until detector C1 exists; it is a proxy, labelled as such.

miss_causes.not_covered: XML instant outside the run's initial scan coverage
miss_causes.never_seen: no observation of a compatible category within tolerance, at any phase, initial or verification
miss_causes.dismissed: a compatible observation existed within tolerance, but no human-facing item matched

time_to_alert.as_run_s: Sum of elapsed_ms of every initial Perception window, plus role calls in trace order up to and including the verification verdict that produced the item (Investigation for an alert without verification). Lower bound: decoding, gaps and retries are not timed.
time_to_alert.live_simulated_s: max(0, end of the initial window containing the XML instant - XML instant) + elapsed of that window's Perception call + role calls in trace order up to the item's verdict.
time_to_alert.trace_alignment: Trace entries '<role>:decision' are paired in order with role_calls; if the counts differ the time is reported as unknown.

report_and_evidence.cited: a human-facing item has at least one cited frame
report_and_evidence.on_time: at least one cited frame within tolerance of the matched XML instant
report_and_evidence.valid_citation: each cited frame id exists in a recorded inspection of the run with the same display_index, source_time_us and rgb24_sha256
report_and_evidence.lead_matches: the report's 'Lead finding' line names the category of a matched critical event

gemini-3.6-flash.source: Google launch pricing, as stated by the project owner on 2026-11-24; the same rates are recorded for gemini-3.8-flash in docs/e1-pilot.md
gemini-3.6-flash.billing: thinking tokens are billed as output; no cache discount

cost_per_camera_month.perception: Perception cost per analysed video minute x 43,200 (all footage, 30 days)
cost_per_camera_month.agents: Reported per run and per human-facing item, not scaled by time: agent calls follow the number of events, not the duration
cost_per_camera_month.two_step_design: Not measurable: detector C1 does not exist yet

run_selection.source: Only the run directories listed in experiments/kpi/runs.txt, written by experiments/kpi/run_all_kpi.sh. Older archived runs are history and are never read.
run_selection.complete: exit code 0, run/analysis.json present, video SHA-256 as above, initial scan completed over the whole video, completion.investigation != 'failed'.
run_selection.failures: Any other listed run is reported as a failure, outside the totals, and counts in a run success rate.
run_selection.wall_time: run_all_kpi.sh records the start and end clock time of each run (meta.json); the real wall time per run is reported.
